icons.name: 鈎索命中標記
icons.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: ONE standalone game HUD skill icon, belonging to a consistent minimalist white ability icon family.
Style: clean simple flat PURE WHITE filled pictogram, bold geometric shapes, large intentional transparent cutouts, smooth edges, readable at 64 pixels. Square canvas, complete icon centered within the middle 76 percent, even generous transparent margins. Actual fully transparent background. All negative spaces must be fully transparent. No background tile, no outline box, no text, letters, numbers, gradients, gray shading, lighting, shadow, glow, grunge, dirt, speckles or distressed texture. No photorealism, no 3D. Simplify detail aggressively. One icon only, not a sheet.
Subject and approved composition: center a simple HEAD-AND-CHEST silhouette of the supplied mushroom enemy. The input image is ONLY its identity reference: preserve the distinctive broad shallow flat mushroom-cap head, long thin stem neck and pointed bony shoulders. Reduce the chest to a simple compact torso with no more than two broad rib cutouts. No arms, no legs, no human face. Above the mushroom crown float ONE prominent solid downward-pointing triangular TARGET MARK with a clear gap. A small curved grappling hook arrives diagonally from the upper left and catches the enemy's left shoulder, with only a short thick rope segment extending upper left. Three simple readable elements: marked enemy bust, floating downward triangle, small attached hook. The enemy silhouette is dominant; triangle is second; hook is subordinate. No crosshair, no targeting brackets, no bullets, no damage numbers, no action arrows.
